title: Alpha Limitations
subtitle: What is intentionally unfinished
description: Honest gaps vs a full production data layer. Plan integrations around these.

callouts.title: Alpha contract
callouts.content: Core lifecycle is usable. Treat missing items below as app-owned until post-alpha.

content: qortex-resource aims to be a form/entity engine, not a full offline-first data platform — yet.

sections.title: Not included (yet)
sections.content:
• Submit lock / AbortSignal on fetch & save
• First-class server field errors (`setErrors`)
• Conflict resolution (etag / version)
• Offline mutation queue
• Multi-tab draft sync
• Auto-refetch on stale / focus / reconnect
• SSR / Suspense helpers
• Toast/UX helpers (status flags only)
• Collection remote pagination

sections.title: Known quirks
sections.content:
• Validation-fail `save()` may leave `mutation.status` as `idle`
• `isError` may not mirror mutation failures the way docs intuitively suggest
• Native refetch can look like full `isLoading`
• Bound React hooks (`createResourceHooks`) = one active identity at a time

sections.title: Solid today
sections.content: Draft overrides, typed paths, field/array editing, Zod, local draft persist, optimistic rollback, mutation status + callbacks, fine-grained React `useField`.
